title: Previous-year paper record
description: One normalized Telangana Police SI / Constable previous-year paper. Registration records intent to acquire; it is not a claim the paper was read. Validated by hand-written checks in tests/pyq/test_pyq_foundation.py (D-0006).

post.description: Which post the paper was for, e.g. 'SI (Civil et al)'. Not an official fact; taken from the source.

paper_number.description: Which paper within the phase, e.g. 3 for FWE Paper III.

year.description: Recruitment year for which the paper was set. null if unknown.

questions_total.description: Number of questions in the printed paper, if known.

source_url_basis.description: How the source URL or copy was obtained. Required, because an inferred URL is not a fact.

blocked_reason.description: Required unless retrieval_status is RETRIEVED or NOT_ATTEMPTED.

response.description: Verbatim. Paraphrasing a failure loses the diagnostic detail that made it worth recording.

normalized_questions.description: Count of questions extracted into pyq/questions/ for this paper.

normalized_questions_status.description: COMPLETE only when every question in the paper is extracted; PARTIAL with a denominator; NONE when nothing extracted.

invariants: source_type == OFFICIAL_PUBLICATION  =>  the source must be a board host; otherwise it is a relocation of provenance and is rejected
retrieval_status == RETRIEVED  =>  local_path, sha256 and retrieved_on are all non-null
retrieval_status not in (RETRIEVED, NOT_ATTEMPTED)  =>  blocked_reason is non-empty AND at least one attempt is recorded
retrieval_status != RETRIEVED  =>  local_path and sha256 must be null
retrieval_status == RETRIEVED  =>  normalized_questions_status != NONE is NOT required; a retrieved paper may legitimately have no questions extracted yet
a previous-year paper is never T1_OFFICIAL; a pattern in it is evidence of behaviour, not policy
